identity: A drawing board with dots, guides, shapes, or map features that the user marks using pointer actions and, in some variants, drawing controls.

scenarios.name: line
scenarios.screen: A board shows either two labeled dots to join or a dot with a direction guide. The board has no drawn attempt.
never: A line already joining the two dots.

arrangements.text: The dots or guide sit within the central board area.
The dots or guide sit in the left portion of the board, leaving more board space to the right.
The dots or guide sit in the lower portion of the board, leaving more board space above.

scenarios.name: circle
scenarios.screen: A board shows a filled center dot and either a dashed circular guide or a hollow dot on the intended rim. No circle has been drawn.

arrangements.text: The center dot and its rim guide occupy the middle of the board.
The circle guide sits toward the right side of the board.
The circle guide sits in the upper portion of the board.

scenarios.hint: Show a filled center dot and hollow circumference dot, or the requested dashed circle guide. No completed stroke. Geometry must support the requested circle.

scenarios.name: trace
scenarios.screen: A board shows a dashed route with a start dot and an arrow tip, usually turning at several corners. No ink follows the route yet.
never: A completed trace over the dashes.

arrangements.text: The dashed route runs across the board from its start dot to its arrow tip.
A smooth dashed wave runs from left to right across most of the board.
The dashed route and its endpoints occupy the upper portion of the board.

scenarios.hint: Show a single clear curved guide path from a start dot to one arrow tip. No extra arrows or already-drawn solution.

scenarios.name: tool
scenarios.screen: A drawing app shows a board with a target line, box, oval, or pen route indicated by dots or a guide. A toolbar contains pen, line, rectangle, ellipse, and Undo; a tool other than the needed one is selected, and the canvas has no drawn item.
never: A completed target shape on the canvas.

arrangements.text: The toolbar sits above the board, and the target marks lie within the board.
The toolbar sits beside the board, and the target marks lie within the board.
The toolbar sits above the board, and the target marks occupy its right portion.

scenarios.name: signature
scenarios.screen: A document shows a title, text lines, and an empty bordered signature field with the signer’s name beneath it. Clear and Accept controls accompany the field.
never: Ink already in the signature field.
An accepted or locked signature field.
A drawing toolbar with shape tools.

arrangements.text: The document text sits above the signature field, with the signer’s name beneath the field and Clear and Accept nearby.
The signature field occupies the left portion of the document, with its signer name directly below.
The signature field occupies the lower portion of the document, beneath the text lines.

scenarios.name: connect
scenarios.screen: A node diagram shows several labeled nodes with input and output ports. Some episodes begin with links that must be kept; the requested new link is absent.
never: Nodes sitting outside the diagram board.

arrangements.text: Labeled nodes are spaced across the board, with links running between their ports.
Labeled nodes are spaced across a narrower board with fewer node columns.
Labeled nodes are spaced across a wider board with more room between columns.

scenarios.name: erase
scenarios.screen: A whiteboard contains several colored doodle strokes, including the stroke or strokes to erase. Pen, eraser, and Undo controls are present, with no new strokes drawn.

arrangements.text: The doodles are spread across the board, with pen, eraser, and Undo controls beside it.
The doodles occupy fewer columns on a narrow board, with the controls above it.
The doodles spread across a wider board, with the controls below it.

scenarios.name: multi
scenarios.screen: A board shows two or three separate targets made from labeled line endpoints and dashed circles. No strokes have been drawn; Undo and Clear controls are available.
never: An extra freehand target outside the displayed set.

arrangements.text: The line endpoints and circle guides occupy separate areas of the board.
All target marks occupy separate areas within the left portion of the board.
All target marks occupy separate areas within the upper portion of the board.

scenarios.name: polygon
scenarios.screen: A map shows streets and sometimes a river. It presents either numbered pins for a polygon or a named lake or park to outline; the Draw area, Undo point, and Clear controls serve the pin task, and no area has been drawn.
never: Pins placed outside the map board.

arrangements.text: Numbered pins sit over the map among the streets, with area controls beside the map.
The numbered pins occupy the left portion of the map while streets continue across it.
The named region occupies the central map area, with streets extending around it.
